name: Local Market Report
tagline: Ask a business question about a Canadian town. Get the answer from Statistics Canada, with the source on every number.
audience: Small business owners, people opening a business, bookkeepers and advisors
before: You want to know if a town can support another coffee shop, a contractor or a store. The numbers exist at Statistics Canada, but they are spread over hundreds of tables and hard to find.
after: You ask the question in plain words. The tool finds the right Statistics Canada tables, pulls the numbers for that town, and writes a short report. Every number names the table it came from.
price_note: Planned: $149 per report. The first reports are done by request while the tool is being finished.
privacy_note: Uses public Statistics Canada data only.
origin: Internal name: StatCan Atlas. It runs on our own computer today, so reports are made by request instead of online.
built_with: Built with AI agents on the Statistics Canada open data service.
